name: How long does a typical mobility-focused bathroom remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical mobility-focused bathroom remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a mobility-focused bathroom remodel can range from a few days for minor installations to several weeks for comprehensive renovations. Factors influencing the timeline include the extent of demolition, installation of new plumbing or electrical, custom tile work, and the availability of specialized fixtures like roll-in showers or accessible vanities. Our team aims to provide a clear timeline after the initial assessment and design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mobility-focused bathroom remodels can take days for minor changes or several weeks for comprehensive renovations, depending on project complexity.
